items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now, when you played with him...

ctx.x: Yeah, well, that goes along the way some people think. Of course, you might say that in comparison to Coleman Hawkins' sound or even Ben Webster, you might say that his sound wasn't quite as big at times as Ben Webster's
sound or Coleman Hawkins' or Chu Berry and what have you. (inaudible). But most of the time his sound was pretty good.
Now, when you played with him, did you find him to be like a guy who improvised a lot or a guy who had a lot of pet phrases and stuff that he used?
